newsitem.title: USA: Barnes Group adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Barnes Group adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Barnes Group Inc said Tuesday that its board adopted a stockholder rights plan to protect the company and its stockholders from coercive takeover tactics.
The company said its original rights plan expired earlier this year.
The rights are exercisable if 35 percent or more of the company's common stock is acquired or targeted for acquisition, Barnes said.

They will be distributed as a dividend at the rate of one right for each Barnes Group common share, par value $1 per share of the company, held by stockholders of record December 23, 1996. The rights expire December 23, 2006, the company said.
Each right initially entitles stockholders to buy one unit of a share of preferred stock for $200, Barnes said.
